messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: The treatment involved an 80 mg IV bolus.
This was followed by a continuous infusion of 8 mg/hr for 3 days.
After this period, therapy may be continued with an oral PPI.
Triplet: ["Pantoprazole", "has duration of administration", "3 days"]

The relation 'has duration of administration' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is administered for the duration specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has duration of treatment': The subject drug is typically taken for the length of time specified by the object entity.
B. 'has effect duration': The subject drug's effect on a specific process lasts for a duration specified by the object entity.
C. 'has availability date': The subject drug has been available since the time period specified by the object entity.
D. 'used during': The subject drug is administered or utilized during the specific phase or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'detectable in system for': The subject drug or its metabolite can be detected in the body for the duration specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
